title: Tryptamines — base / 4-substituted / 5-MeO and unusual
disclaimer: Game catalog research. Unitless 0-100 inferences from public reports. Not a manual. No recipes. No how-to-take. No milligram instructions. Unknown scores are null, never 0. Enjoyment and euphoria lead. Rush is null except launches (DMT blast-off, 5-MeO-DMT freight train — not a pyro). Compulsiveness stays low. Do not clone effects from naming patterns.

scoring.rush_rule: null except DMT launch and 5-MeO-DMT freight train (not a pyro)

do_not_clone.why: audio pitch shift vs short mushroom analog
base tryptamine vs playful mushroom powder
organic fruit vs cleaner silly-pills envelope
4-HO trip with skin vs 5-MeO skin without the mushroom
peripheral snuff storm vs methoxy white-out
body-short couch vs lucid short fun

alias_validations.label: toad / god molecule
alias_validations.note: Same molecule as synthetic 5-MeO-DMT. Theater differs. Mixups with bufotenine.

alias_validations.label: ayahuasca / changa
alias_validations.note: Formats of DMT. Flag brew / maoi_risk. Not extra IDs.

notes: Rush ranking is not a pyro ranking. 5-MeO-DMT is a freight train. DMT is a launch. Oral 4-subs are usually null.
Enjoyment can be high while euphoria is only mid (DMT, psilocin).

gaps: Most later 4-AcO/4-PrO stamps have no distinct street personality — scored null on purpose.
Base EPT/MPT/PiPT/MALT/McPT: vendor/forensic names, do not clone from DPT/MET.
Mushroom minors (baeocystin, norbaeocystin, aeruginascin, norpsilocin): contested or trace.
5-MeO-MET/MPT/EPT/EiPT/iPALT: lists exist; feel not locked.
5-Br/Cl-DMT and 4-MeO series: documented as chemicals, thin as nights.
Psilomethoxin: controversy, not a characterized SKU.
5-MeO-pyr-T / pyr-T: TiHKAL scare, almost no bags.
Ayahuasca is a DMT+MAOI preparation, not a separate molecule (flagged on DMT).
excluded_on_purpose: DBT and other TiHKAL inactives with no circulation

agents.name: DMT

feel.headline: Hyperspace in a hit. Circus, entities, then you're back.

rush.note: Blast-off launch. Not a cathinone spike.

enjoyment.note: Blast-off into geometric rooms and others. Awe more than a roll. Smoked/vaped is a short kidnapping; the brew is a long river of the same molecule, not a different drug.

reinforcement.note: Return for the night, not a binge.

psychosis_concern.note: Often ego-death / freakout, not stim psychosis.

agents.npc_line: Hyperspace in a hit. Circus, entities, then you're back.
agents.not_the_name: Not a long mushroom. Not 5-MeO's white-out. The pictures are the point; 5-MeO forgets to show the pictures.
agents.the_hit: Blast-off into geometric rooms and others. Awe more than a roll. Smoked/vaped is a short kidnapping; the brew is a long river of the same molecule, not a different drug.
agents.the_bill: Launch terror, ego-rip, leftover unreality. The brew adds gut war. Not a pyro rush — a cannon into another place.
